title: Locale-aware hybrid cross-encoder fusion for low-latency rerank
creator: Aisha Rahman
description:
Goal: select and validate a hybrid reranking approach that fuses a lightweight locale-aware cross-encoder with a dual-encoder fast-scoring fallback to meet multilingual quality targets while holding p95 latency under the 120ms budget for single-request rerank.

Scope:
- Candidate models: ce-compact-v3 (locale-adapted), ce-multi-xl-lite (quantized), ce-distill-locale (distilled per-region), dual-encoder+dot (cached embeddings).
- Evaluate across en, es, fr, ja, pt, de, ko and two low-resource locales (vi, id).
- Metrics: NDCG@10, MRR, P@1, latency p50/p95, memory footprint, cost tokens/sec equivalent.
- Regression criteria: no >1.5% absolute drop in NDCG@10 vs baseline on hi-fi eval set; p95 latency increase must be <=20% and remain <=120ms; error rate increase <=0.1%.

Plan:
1) Localized evaluation harness (by 2026-03-05): build balanced eval set with 15k queries spanning web/search/canned prompts, include synthetic adversarial cases for locale-specific morphology.
2) Benchmark candidates on runtime-1.21 infra with production traffic sampler (10k QPS sampled traces) to measure realistic prefix lengths and KV cache hit distributions (by 2026-03-12).
3) Decide model family and fallback policy: either single cross-encoder variant with quantization profile OR hybrid mode where dual-encoder shortlist is re-scored by compact CE for long-tail locales; document trade-offs.
4) Implement staged rollout: lab -> canary 1% (observability flags) -> canary 10% -> ramp 50% -> 100%. Add automatic rollback if regression triggers.
5) Post-rollout monitoring: NDCG drift alerts, per-locale latency SLO dashboards, memory OOM alarms, and a monthly quality audit with product.

Artifacts & links:
- Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PRD/pages/789012/locale-aware-rerank-fusion
- Evaluation harness code (repo): https://github.com/redwood-inference/rerank-eval/tree/ENG-52389
- Benchmark results dashboard: https://observability.redwood.ai/dashboards/ENG-52389-rerank-bench
- Draft rollout runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xyz-RERANK-ENG52389

Trade-offs considered:
- Single high-capacity CE gives best quality but higher cost and memory; harder to serve in Dedicated constrained pools.
- Hybrid dual-encoder shortlist + compact CE rerank reduces average cost and keeps tail latency stable but adds complexity in routing and cache consistency.
- Locale-specific distillation improves low-resource quality but increases maintenance surface for model versions and releases.

Decision checkpoints:
- If compact CE quantized meets NDCG target within 10% cost uplift and p95 <120ms we prefer single-model rollout.
- Otherwise adopt hybrid with strict cache invalidation policy and 0.5s backend deadline for CE re-score to avoid client timeouts.
